scripts.pages:build: bun src/compiler/compileCache.ts && bun scripts/rebuildPages.ts && bun run compile-js
scripts.build:all: bun run db:fetch && bun run pages:build
scripts.pages:deploy: aws s3 sync ./dist/pages s3://pages --endpoint-url https://8a48bde066e009089f9f8e944792d619.r2.cloudflarestorage.com --content-type "text/html; charset=utf-8" --profile r2
